items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The regular opera company, like with Anna Pavlova and things like that -- oh, they came from New York.

ctx.x: Oh, for the opera. When the opera came, was that an opera company from Puerto Rico or from the States?
No, from New York. The regular opera company, like with Anna Pavlova and things like that -- oh, they came from New York. The best, and the best directors, and so forth.
So you played also for the ballet?
